subject: pol-dym
title: POL.DYM.------SOC.RT.
description: Chart on book p. 323 (R(AS)CM(I)-7). POL-DYM (political dynamics) is the subject, with the (C) prefix, "the concept of"; SOC-RT (social reality) is the partner. From the subject: T-C-IMP (time continuum implications) and PART (participation). From T-C-IMP: COS-D (cosmic dictates). From PART: MOT-DY, INDIV-DY-RT (individual dynamic reality) and INTR (interpretation). From INTR: AFL-DY (affinity dynamics).
